maintenance_led.reason: Project-based economic litigation and management consulting for law firms and corporations; not repair, servicing or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are mainly law firms, corporations and accounting firms; governments are only a minor client group.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by hiring experts and winning consulting and litigation engagements, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Per-matter consulting and expert engagements; clients can hire other economic consultancies for new matters.

notes: Switching mid-litigation can be disruptive, but engagements are generally per-matter and competitive.
